context: Tests whether the response provides an actionable OpenTelemetry JS 3.0 readiness audit before October 15, including Node runtime compatibility, removed packages, tracing API migrations, and the limits of custom instrumentation compatibility claims.

checklist.name: Verifies stable release status
checklist.description: Checks the stable release/tag and npm latest dist-tag; explicitly distinguishes stable from development/canary versions and does not rely on the planned release date.

checklist.name: Audits Node.js runtime floors
checklist.description: Identifies Node.js >=22.15.0 as the announced SDK 3.0 minimum (with package-specific exemptions for API and semantic conventions), checks engines and runtime pin files, and validates CI/deployment runtimes.

checklist.name: Finds removed packages
checklist.description: Flags the Jaeger exporter/propagator, OpenTracing/OpenCensus shims, api-logs, and split sdk-trace-base/node/web packages for removal; proposes supported alternatives only after consulting the final migration guide.

checklist.name: Updates tracing SDK imports and APIs
checklist.description: Migrates to `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace`, replaces `BasicTracerProvider` with `TracerProvider`, reviews explicit provider/context/propagator registration, and updates span processor construction to the options-object form.

checklist.name: Qualifies custom instrumentation compatibility
checklist.description: Separates the API-only compatibility assurance from `@opentelemetry/instrumentation` and SDK-internal compatibility; requires manual review and tests for `InstrumentationBase` subclasses and internal/removed imports.

checklist.name: Provides useful static scanner and validation plan
checklist.description: Scanner covers Node declarations, removed dependencies, legacy trace SDK imports, and custom instrumentation references; describes heuristic limitations and requires tests on the minimum supported runtime.
